answer_1.quote: The task addressed in our work is that of automatically generating Natural Language Landmark Navigation Instructions (NLLNI) from realworld open-source geographical data from OpenStreetMap.
datasets: 7,672 instances of routes in OpenStreetMap and corresponding crowd-sourced natural language instructions
answer_1.outputs: natural language route instructions that contain salient landmarks

answer_2.quote: BLEU is calculated with SacreBLEU on lower-cased and tokenized text. ... Landmarks is the number of landmark occurrences per instance. ... SDTW is success weighted by normalized Dynamic Time Warping. ... SNT is success weighted by navigation time.

answer_4.quote: Another annotator will later read your instructions in order to find the goal location in StreetView (Navigation Run Task). If the other annotator successfully navigates to the goal location, your instruction is validated.
answer_4.guideline: The task is successful if the annotator stops the run within a 25 meter radius around the goal location.
